metadata.question: Does the snow cover extent in the Tinguiririca basin (specifically -34.752733, -70.647985) on December 18, 2023, exceed the average snow cover observed on December 18 from 2017 to 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Snow Cover products (MOD10A1 or MYD10A1) which provide daily snow cover data - Need data for December 18, 2023 (single day) and December 18 for years 2017-2022 (6 days) - Location: Point at -34.752733, -70.647985 (Tinguiririca basin, Chile) 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS snow products have quality flags and cloud masks - Need to mask clouds and use only valid snow cover observations - Snow cover is typically stored as NDSI_Snow_Cover band (0-100 scale) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid zero = no snow cover (legitimate answer) - C1 = No images found for the dates - C2 = Images exist but all pixels masked (clouds) - C3 = Calculation returns None/NaN - Need to check collection size and valid pixel counts ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-70.647985, -34.752733]); const date2023 = ee.Date('2023-12-18'); const historicalYears = [2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022]; // 2. Data Acquisition for 2023 let col2023 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(date2023, date2023.advance(1, 'day')) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); let size2023 = col2023.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2023-12-18 Images: ${size2023}`); if (size2023 === 0) { // Try Terra+Aqua combined col2023 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD10A1') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(date2023, date2023.advance(1, 'day')) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); size2023 = col2023.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2023-12-18 Aqua Images: ${size2023}`); } if (size2023 === 0) { console.log("No data for 2023-12-18."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Process 2023 data const img2023 = col2023.first(); const snowCover2023Raw = img2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const snowCover2023 = snowCover2023Raw.getInfo(); if (snowCover2023 === null || snowCover2023 === undefined) { console.log("2023 data invalid (likely masked)."); console.log("C2"); return; } console.log(`2023-12-18 Snow Cover: ${snowCover2023.toFixed(2)}%`); // 4. Data Acquisition for Historical Years (2017-2022) const historicalValues = []; for (const year of historicalYears) { const dateStr = `${year}-12-18`; const startDate = ee.Date(dateStr); const endDate = startDate.advance(1, 'day'); let colYear = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const sizeYear = colYear.size().getInfo(); if (sizeYear === 0) { colYear = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD10A1') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); } const sizeYearFinal = colYear.size().getInfo(); if (sizeYearFinal > 0) { const imgYear = colYear.first(); const snowCoverYear = imgYear.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); if (snowCoverYear !== null && snowCoverYear !== undefined) { historicalValues.push(snowCoverYear); console.log(`${year}-12-18: ${snowCoverYear.toFixed(2)}%`); } else { console.log(`${year}-12-18: No valid data`); } } else { console.log(`${year}-12-18: No images`); } } // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (historicalValues.length === 0) { console.log("No valid historical data found."); console.log("C1"); return; } const avgHistorical = historicalValues.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / historicalValues.length; console.log(`Historical Average (${historicalValues.length} years): ${avgHistorical.toFixed(2)}%`); if (snowCover2023 > avgHistorical) { console.log(`2023 (${snowCover2023.toFixed(2)}%) > Historical Avg (${avgHistorical.toFixed(2)}%)`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`2023 (${snowCover2023.toFixed(2)}%) <= Historical Avg (${avgHistorical.toFixed(2)}%)`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
